attacks.alie: full-knowledge A Little Is Enough: every attacker sampled in a round reports mean - z * std of the honest updates of that round, with z from the published formula for n sampled clients and m sampled attackers (clamped below a corrupted majority)
attacks.mimic: public-information free-rider: report the previous round's aggregate update (zero in round one); requires no training and no access to other clients' current updates, so commit-reveal does not prevent it

method: original published frozen scorer and parameters; historical source loaded only after digest verification
extensions: unchanged published CGSV/RFFL kernels and pilot-selected parameters; shadow rewards only
trajectory: unchanged server protocol of fltoken.experiment: sample-count-weighted FedAvg over all sampled reported updates; every rule sees one identical immutable matrix
order: seed-major, so an interrupted run leaves complete seeds
